context_compaction.note: No code or config is available to show how history is compacted.

observation_format.evidence_quote: We store in each node the text from the corresponding entity’s code and position metadata.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: It is prompted using two edit formats: search/replace and edit_file (Figure 3).
edit_primitive.note: The semantics of edit_file are shown only in Figure 3. It is mapped to line_range_edit as the closest value; this mapping is uncertain.

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency list or code is available to grep for mcp, a2a or acp.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: proceeds to resolve issues in two stages: (1) localization and (2) repair
loop_primitives.note: The fixed localization-then-repair pipeline contains an iterative localization agent (react) and 7 candidate patches with selection (multi_attempt).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: proceeds to resolve issues in two stages: (1) localization and (2) repair
planning_granularity.note: The stages are a fixed pipeline; no plan object is described. This is inferred from paper prose only.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: proceeds to resolve issues in two stages: (1) localization and (2) repair
multi_agent_topology.note: The localization agent hands off to patch generation and an LLM judge. Coded pipeline; single is also plausible.

self_verification.evidence_quote: We then run regression tests and LLM-generated reproduction tests on each candidate to remove those that fail these tests.
self_verification.note: Syntax-error filtering is coded as linters_typecheck. The paper also says: 'we use LLM-as-a-judge for the final selection'.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Concretely in our work we generate 7 patches per problem instance with the o3 model from OpenAI.
retry_policy.note: These are parallel candidates with selection, not sequential retries; fixed_n is the closest value.

cost_controls.note: The paper reports a cost of $3.28 per problem but describes no cost control mechanism.
